thread:
Maria H: FYI — Looker dashboard shows a 28% drop in webinar-to-demo conversion this week vs last. anyone else seeing this?
AJ: saw that too. raw events look flat. suspect sampling on the lead pipeline export.
Kevin L: can you point to the dashboard link? 
Maria H: https://looker.redwood/dashboards/marketing/perf-weekly - top panel (registrations -> demos).
Olivia S: quick check: are we mixing sampled GA4 exports with full event stream? thats been tripping us up. :grimacing:
Samir: confirmed — the nightly lead export uses a 10% sample for high-volume sources since the 3/14 ingest change. metrics-bot flagged sample_rate=0.1 on the export.
Maria H: ohhh that would explain. can we estimate impact?
Samir: rough calc — if raw demos are ~900 last week, sampling to 10% gives 90 in the export; downstream joins to sf_leads inflate the conversion rate variance.
AJ: suggestion: until we fix ingest, add a sampled vs. unsampled toggle on the dashboard and mark calls-to-action with a note. also, revert the export to 100% for source:webinar if possible.
Kevin L: we can filter export by `source='webinar'` and keep 100% for that path. small SQL snippet I ran locally: ```SELECT event_time, utm_source, sample_flag FROM nightly_exports WHERE source='webinar' AND event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-15';```
Maria H: perfect. Olivia — can you add an annotation to the dashboard and a banner in the weekly KPI report?
Olivia S: on it. I'll add an orange annotation: "3/14 ingest sampling introduced — numbers for high-volume sources may be undercounted." and add a footnote in Friday KPI deck.
Samir: I'll override sampling for webinar source tonight, push to prod by 22:00 UTC. If anything breaks I'll ping in this thread.
AJ: also want to capture conversion delta so analysts can show adjusted vs reported numbers in the KPI review. Samir can you export both sampled and corrected counts?
Samir: yes — will output a small csv to S3: s3://redwood-marketing/exports/webinar_counts_1732109876.csv
metrics-bot: Automated check: dashboard refresh succeeded, sample_rate detected=0.10, anomaly_score=0.7 — see /alerts/6732
Kevin L: next steps: 1) Samir override sampling for webinar, 2) Olivia annotate dash + update KPI deck, 3) AJ add sampled/unsampled toggle, 4) Maria include corrected numbers in Friday sync.
Maria H: thanks all. putting this on today's agenda at 10:30 for the weekly KPI huddle.
Olivia S: I'll draft the slide with both numbers and note the temporary data caveat.
AJ: if anyone wants to test the toggle locally, here's the API query pattern: `GET /api/v1/metrics?source=webinar&sample_override=true`
Samir: pushed change at 21:58 UTC — export now set to 100% for webinar.
Maria H: confirmed — numbers look aligned now, conversion back to ~26%. adding to the Friday deck. :tada:
Kevin L: great — closing the loop, we should add a doc to marketing-runbook about sample flags and dashboard treatment. I'll create a short RFC after the KPI sync.
